role: Generated table of the biome creature spawn lists performWorldGenSpawning reads, taken from the live oracle biome objects after WorldConf.pruneSpawns removed horses, wolves and ocelots: the default four-entry list, the jungle's (with the extra chicken), the mushroom island's mooshroom list, and a biome id to list index map.

structs.name: SW_LIST_DEFAULT
structs.java: the four creature entries every BiomeGenBase constructor adds (sheep 12, pig 10, chicken 10, cow 8), after pruneSpawns removed the horse entries

structs.name: SW_LIST_JUNGLE
structs.java: BiomeGenJungle's creature list: the default four plus a chicken entry (the ocelot entry is pruned)

structs.name: SW_BIOME_LIST
structs.java: BiomeGenBase.biomeList id to creature-list index (0 empty, 1 default, 2 mooshroom, 3 jungle, -1 unregistered)

notes: Read-only static const tables, GPU-friendly. Only the creature type is covered; the monster, water and ambient lists live elsewhere (spawning.c, not verified). Included only by seedworld.c (sw_creatures); the test is indirect, through the seed-world build. The BiomeGenJungle and BiomeGenMushroomIsland member names are the constructors where those lists are filled, inferred rather than read line by line. Generated from the oracle's --spawndump creatures.jsonl, per the header comment; regenerate rather than hand-edit.
